subject: TheraPix security discovery — pen test report & remediation SLAs
messages:
From: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.com>
To: Samantha Ruiz <samantha@therapix.com>, Alex Turner <alex.turner@therapix.com>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-08T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: TheraPix security discovery — notes & next steps (pen test + SLA questions)

Hi Samantha / Alex — thanks again for the call this morning. Quick recap and a proposed next steps list so we stay aligned on compliance items that matter to the TheraPix product team.

Recap (from our call):
- SOC 2: In progress, Type 1 completed June 2026; Type 2 expected Q1 2027.
- Regulated data: TheraPix confirmed HIPAA scope for PHI in scope, and GDPR applies for EU users.
- Current toolset: you run quarterly authenticated scans (SAST/DAST) and engage a third-party pen test annually.

Redwood asks / items we need to qualify:
1) Can you share the most recent pen test report (redacted OK) and the cadence you expect going forward?
2) What SLAs do you commit to for vulnerability remediation by severity (Critical / High / Medium)?
3) Do you have a published vulnerability disclosure policy or a channel for researchers?
4) We'll start the vendor security questionnaire — attaching our fillable sheet. Can you assign a security PO to own this?

Proposed next steps:
- You send redacted pen test PDF and a summary of remediation SLAs by 11/11.
- We exchange an MPA / mutual action plan draft (DocuSign link below) to map deliverables (SOC2 checkpoints + evidence).
- Schedule a short follow-up on 11/12 to review any gaps (30 minutes).

Attachments: redwood-vendor-questionnaire-fillable.xlsx (fillable QnA template)
Related links: https://app.docusign.com/link/TPX-MAP-2026

Thanks — I can be flexible on timing for the follow-up.

Best,
Logan Wright
Enterprise AE | Redwood Inference
logan.wright@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0129

From: Samantha Ruiz <samantha@therapix.com>
To: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.com>, Alex Turner <alex.turner@therapix.com>
Cc: Chris Delaney <c.delaney@therapix.com>
Date: 2026-11-09T10:22:00-08:00
Subject: Re: TheraPix security discovery — notes & next steps (pen test + SLA questions)

Thanks Logan — great to speak with you all. Per your request, attaching a redacted copy of our most recent third-party pen test from Sept 2026. The full report contains customer-identifying details so we’ve removed PII and node identifiers.

Quick answers: 
- Pen test cadence: annual full-scope third-party pen tests (last: 2026-09). We run authenticated DAST monthly and SCA weekly.
- Remediation SLAs: target SLAs internally are: Critical = 30 days, High = 60 days, Medium = 120 days. For critical customer-impacting issues we escalate to our CTO and target emergency fixes within 14 days.
- Vulnerability disclosure: we maintain a security@therapix.com inbox and a published disclosure page; we’ll share the URL in a follow-up.

See attached: therapix-penreport-redacted-sep2026.pdf (redacted). We’re happy to fill your vendor questionnaire — assigning Alex to own the responses.

Can you confirm the scope you need in the pen test (external only vs. internal network & cloud config)? That will help prioritize remediation.

Best,
Samantha Ruiz
Head of Security Operations | TheraPix Health
samantha@therapix.com
[attachment: therapix-penreport-redacted-sep2026.pdf (PDF, 1.1MB)]

From: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>
To: Samantha Ruiz <samantha@therapix.com>, Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.com>
Cc: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-09T14:03:00-08:00
Subject: Re: TheraPix security discovery — notes & next steps (pen test + SLA questions)

Samantha — appreciate the quick turn. A couple clarifying items from the Redwood compliance side: 

- Scope: For our SOC/GDPR/HIPAA review we typically ask for the pen test to include external attack surface + authenticated application tests. If you also include a basic cloud configuration review (IAM + network ACLs) that’s very helpful; please flag if that was included in the Sept report.
- SLAs: Your internal target SLAs look reasonable. For contract language our security team usually requests correlated timelines and a vendor commitment for criticals (e.g., Critical <= 30 days, with interim mitigations documented within 48 hours). Would you be open to that language in the MPA?
- Disclosure: can you confirm if the security@ inbox is monitored 24/7 and if you have a triage SLA for reported vulnerabilities?

If helpful, we can provide a short template clause for the MPA and a suggested remediation table. I’ll add our suggested language to the vendor questionnaire and re-upload.

Thanks — Lauren
Manager, Security Partnerships | Redwood Inference

From: Alex Turner <alex.turner@therapix.com>
To: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>, Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.com>
Cc: Samantha Ruiz <samantha@therapix.com>, Chris Delaney <c.delaney@therapix.com>
Date: 2026-11-10T09:15:00-08:00
Subject: Re: TheraPix security discovery — notes & next steps (pen test + SLA questions)

Hi Lauren — thanks for the context. Confirming answers from our side: 
- Sept report scope: external web app + authenticated API + limited cloud config review (IAM findings only). Internal network tests were out of scope for that engagement.
- Disclosure triage: security@therapix.com is monitored during business hours; we have an on-call rotation for escalation evenings/weekends (contact routing documented internally). We aim to acknowledge reports within 24 hours; triage timelines depend on severity.
- MPA clause: we’re open to the Critical <=30 days commitment with documented interim mitigations within 48 hours. Need legal review on language but can get that sign-off.

I’ll own filling out the vendor questionnaire by 11/12 and upload via the Drive link you sent. If Redwood needs the internal-network testing included we can provision that for a targeted engagement (timeline + cost to be provided).

— Alex
Security Engineer | TheraPix Health
[no attachments]

From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.com>
To: Samantha Ruiz <samantha@therapix.com>, Alex Turner <alex.turner@therapix.com>, Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.com>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-12T16:04:00-08:00
Subject: Re: TheraPix security discovery — notes & next steps (pen test + SLA questions)

Samantha / Alex — thanks for the documents and quick answers. Action items from Redwood side: 
1) Logan / I will draft the MPA with the remediation clause (Critical <=30 days + 48-hour interim mitigation) and share via DocuSign by EOD 11/13.
2) Please upload the completed vendor questionnaire to the Drive link (https://drive.google.com/open?id=1a2BqV-therapix-security-qna) by 11/12 end of day — Alex indicated he will upload; if not, please let us know.
3) We’d like the pen test to explicitly confirm whether any remediation for Critical findings required customer action (we need to know if TheraPix required changes on customer-configured integrations). If that’s not captured in the redacted report, can you provide a short summary?

If the questionnaire and MPA are aligned, we’ll proceed to a short review call on 11/15 to finalize acceptance criteria for the pilot. Please confirm availability for a 30-minute slot on 11/15 between 10–12 PT.

Best regards,
Evelyn Hart
Sr. Security Partnerships Lead | Redwood Inference
[attachments: redwood-vendor-questionnaire-fillable.xlsx]
